tools.name: scan_website
tools.description: Scan a public website and report how ready it is for AI agents and AI search: which checks pass, which are missing, and what each check is, in plain English and technically. Covers 35 checks in three groups: agent readiness (robots.txt and AI crawler rules, sitemap, Link headers, DNS-AID, markdown f

tools.name: explain_check
tools.description: Explain one agent-readiness check in depth: what it is, why it matters for AI agents and AI search, exactly how the scanner tests it, what counts as a pass, and the official sources. Call with no check_id to list every check.
